meta.description: Auto-refreshed weekly pass seeding obvious starters missed by the injury-report heuristic in build-projected-starters.js. Derived from real Week 10 2026 usage stats (player_stats_weekly.csv) -- top usage player at each team/position where usage clearly dominates the next player at that position (>= 1.8x, above a position-specific volume floor). QBs are high-confidence; RB/WR/TE are single-game samples and flagged needs_human_review. This file is fully overwritten each run -- it never accumulates stale entries from prior weeks.
